h1_offset.frame: pelvis frame: 'along' is the hip->hip axis (+ = toward the right hip), 'perp' is perpendicular to it in the image

h2_substitutions.spine: AthleticsPose uses mean(Xiphoid, T10). MoVi has no Xiphoid marker; STRN ('Sternum') is the closest anatomical equivalent, the xiphoid process lying at the inferior sternum.
h2_substitutions.neck: AthleticsPose uses mean(CLAV, Nasion). MoVi has no Nasion; the midpoint of LFHD and RFHD ('Left/Right Front Head') is the closest available anterior head landmark.
h2_substitutions.head: AthleticsPose uses mean(Vertex, EARC). MoVi has neither; HEAD ('Head Center') is the dataset's own head centre.
h2_substitutions.l_wrist/r_wrist: AthleticsPose uses LWRT/RWRT. MoVi ships the wrist bar pair LWRA/LWRB ('Wrist Bar Thumb/Pinkie Side'); their midpoint is the wrist centre.
